_meta.name: Golden Flow Reference
_meta.description: Expected pipeline output at each pass for any MoSPI statistical report. Use this to validate each pass produces correct intermediate data before the next pass consumes it.

pass0_text_extraction._expect: Clean text per page. Ghost tables filtered. Real tables preserved with proper cell structure.
signals_of_success: Ghost tables (>30 cols, <20% fill) = 0 per page
Real tables have proper headers (not col_0, col_1...)
Headings detected from bold/large font words
Total chars > 0 for text pages (not scanned)

example_page.note: Ghost table (128x88, 4% filled) was filtered. Page has vector pie charts but pdfplumber can't see them — LayoutLM + VLM handle this.

example_table_page.table_1_title_detected: Table 1.1: Statewise Estimated Reserves of Coal (As on 1st April 2025)

pass1_layout_detection._expect: LayoutLM identifies region types (heading, text, table, figure) from rasterized page image. DocLayNet 11-class model.
signals_of_success: Figure regions detected on pages with vector charts (pages 3-6)
Table regions detected on pages 7-9
Heading regions at top of narrative pages
Confidence > 0.55 for all kept regions

toc_expected.title: Geographical Distribution of Renewable Energy Potential

pass2_vlm_entities._expect: VLM (Qwen/Gemini) sees page images and extracts entity names + chart types. This is the ONLY source for chart detection on vector-drawn PDFs.
signals_of_success: chart_types detected on pages 3-6 (pie_chart)
structure_type = mixed for pages with text + charts
structure_type = data_table for pages 7-9
Entities are real column headers / indicator names, NOT section headings

chart_titles: Estimated Reserves of Coal in India
Estimated Reserves of Lignite in India

example_page_7.table_title: Table 1.1: Statewise Estimated Reserves of Coal

pass2_5_knowledge_graph._expect: Programmatic assembly of entities from 4 sources (table headers priority 0 > headings > VLM > regex). Table structures with proper dims/measures.
signals_of_success: Table headers registered as priority-0 entities
Real measures: Proved, Indicated, Inferred, Total, Distribution (%)
Real dimensions: States/UTs, Energy Source
Chapter headings NOT registered as entities (filtered by hygiene)
Table structures have dimensions AND measures (not all col_N)

expected_table_structures.tableTitle: Table 1.1: Statewise Estimated Reserves of Coal
Table 1.3: Statewise Estimated Reserves of Crude Oil and Natural Gas
Table 1.4: Sourcewise and Statewise Estimated Potential of Renewable Power

pass2_6_entity_classification._expect: Each entity gets entityType_hint (measure/dimension/filter/metadata). LLM batch-classifies ambiguous ones.
signals_of_success: Table header measures (Proved, Indicated, Total) → measure
First column of tables (States/UTs) → dimension
Entities with 'reserves', 'potential', 'distribution' → measure
State names (if individual) → dimension
No heading-phrases as entities (filtered earlier)

pass3_questions_topics._expect: LLM generates domain-specific analytical questions from clean entity context. Each question has requiredEntities + analyticsSpec + answerStructure.
signals_of_success: Questions reference REAL entity names (Proved, States/UTs) not col_0
questionType is specific (comparison, ranking, trend) not generic describe
requiredEntities have proper roles (measure, groupBy, filter)
answerStructure has chart + table + narrative components
inferenceMethod = LLM (not programmatic_chapter fallback)

expected_questions.intent: What is the statewise distribution of coal reserves across States/UTs for 2025?
Which States have the highest total coal reserves and what is their share in national reserves?
What is the composition of coal reserves by reserve category (Proved, Indicated, Inferred)?

pass4_final_assembly._expect: Gold-standard AST + Blueprint. Every ID cross-references. Entities have proper entityType/unit/format. Tables have columnGroups. Charts wired to questions.

ast_tables_expected.title: Table 1.1: Statewise Estimated Reserves of Coal

ghost_tables.symptom: 89-column tables with col_0..col_88 headers in output
ghost_tables.cause: pdfplumber detects PDF drawing objects (borders/gridlines) as table cells
ghost_tables.fix: _is_ghost_table() filter: >30 cols AND <20% fill rate → reject

generic_questions.symptom: Questions say 'What are the key findings in section X?'
generic_questions.cause: Entity list has no measures (all dimension) → chapter-fallback produces generic questions
generic_questions.fix: Ghost table filter + proper header merge → clean measures reach entity list → LLM generates specific questions

no_charts_detected.symptom: chartAST.charts = 0 even though PDF has pie charts
no_charts_detected.cause: Vector-drawn charts (curves, not images) invisible to pdfplumber. LayoutLM not running. VLM provider failing.
no_charts_detected.fix: Start LayoutLM service (detects figure regions) + ensure VLM provider responds (identifies chart_types from image)

heading_as_entity.symptom: Entities like 'CHAPTER 1 Energy Reserves and Potential Introduction'
heading_as_entity.cause: Entity hygiene not rejecting long heading phrases
heading_as_entity.fix: _classify_entity_name rejects: chapter_heading pattern + >40 chars with 5+ words

table_title_as_header.symptom: First column header is 'Table 1.1: Statewise Estimated...' (full title text)
table_title_as_header.cause: Row 0 is a title row spanning all columns, not a header
table_title_as_header.fix: _analyze_table_header detects title rows (single non-null cell matching Table/Statement pattern) and skips them

year_row_as_data.symptom: Headers show only top-level labels (Proved, Indicated) without year qualifiers
year_row_as_data.cause: Year sub-header row (2024, 2025) classified as data by _looks_like_data_row
year_row_as_data.fix: Year-like values (20XX) in mostly-empty rows treated as header qualifiers, not data

layoutlm.role: Visual region detection (heading, text, table, figure, caption)

vlm_qwen.role: Entity extraction + chart type identification from page images
vlm_qwen.fallback_when_down: pdfplumber headings + table headers only (no chart detection)

groq.role: Question generation (pass3 loop1) + entity binding (pass3 loop2) + entity classification (pass2.6)
groq.critical_for: Domain-specific analytical questions with proper analyticsSpec
groq.fallback_when_down: Programmatic fallback (archetype templates + chapter-based generic questions)

gemini.role: ToC extraction (L3 fallback) + gap fill + fact extraction + pass5 enrichment
gemini.critical_for: Semantic hierarchy nodes + glossary + missing question coverage
gemini.fallback_when_down: Pipeline still produces valid output; just less rich
